# Copilot instructions

Follow every instruction in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

This is a vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript learning project. Do not introduce frameworks or libraries. Help the student understand and modify the existing API flow rather than replacing it.

Every generated or substantially rewritten code region must be wrapped in AI citation comments containing the student's prompt, and every such interaction must also be reflected in the visible `citations.html` page. Never remove existing citations.
